transcript: Last night, my friend Marie and I went to see Oliver at New York City Center as part of their encore season. I had mixed feelings. It's such a strange show and that the plot doesn't feel very focused and leaves a lot of loose ends, and I found myself not very invested in the characters. I also find the score generally pretty annoying, as it has this, like, aggressive insistence, but it does have some pretty catchy melodies here and there. That said, this was a super solid production of, in my opinion, not a super solid show for the encore series. You don't tend to expect a very intricate staging, as it's such a brief rehearsal period, but this production felt very full in terms of blocking, choreography, and everyone was so talented. The performances were great. I mean, the kids were, like, amazing. They were so cute, and they were so good at singing and dancing, and some of them were, like, doing flips on stage. It was wild. So overall, definitely still a good time. With that. Another playbook for my collection.
